answer: Latency-anchored physical beacon: each operator runs a hardware beacon emitting a continuous timing signal tied to a fixed physical address, like a river's flow gauge. Agents must cite a fresh beacon reading co-signed by their local grove's onyx-logged clock. A single operator cannot fake the independent phase noise of many beacons across real locations, since duplicating one requires placing hardware there. Attacker cost: one physical device plus address per identity, plus continuous power and monitoring.
